name: Quality rating
pick: A viewing test: people look at each image (for example from several image generators or codecs) and rate it on a scale: quality, realism, aesthetics.
summary: Look at images and rate their quality, from 1 to 5.
suggest: Also ask how well it matches the prompt

examples.question: How realistic does this image look?
examples.title: How real does it look?

settings.title: How good does it look?
settings.instructions: Look at each image, then rate its quality: sharpness, colours and anything that looks wrong. Click the image to see it larger.
settings.question: How good is the quality of this image?
